title: Reconstruct image as semantic geometry and SVG
steps: Define incidence, angle rays, equal-mark relations and claims before coordinates.
Construct only needed points/feet/intersections/centers with explicit branch and extent.
Keep source assertions separate from chosen illustrative coordinates.
Render styled SVG and PNG; compare printed object coverage.
stopWhen: Degenerate geometry or unsupported source constraint would be hidden.
limitation: A reusable execution recipe; historical success does not certify a different source or current native environment.
